_comment: Versioned registry of manually reviewed, company-owned newsroom/IR RSS-Atom feeds. Every entry passes the same _validate_feed gate as PRESS_RELEASE_FEEDS env entries: HTTPS feed URL on the recorded owner domain, HTTPS terms URL on the same owner domain, and a manual review date. Review evidence, 2026-07-18 (Claude review pass): each feed URL was fetched live (HTTP 200, RSS or XML content type) and parsed with the collector's own parser, returning current items whose links resolve on the owner domain. Terms pages: salesforce.com and micron.com returned HTTP 200; intel.com, sap.com and cisco.com legal pages returned HTTP 403 to a non-browser client (bot-gated) and render normally in a browser. Boeing's newsroom was deliberately NOT admitted because it is hosted on a vendor domain (boeing.mediaroom.com) that fails the company-owned-domain rule.

feeds.name: Intel Newsroom
feeds.retired_reason: Intel retired its newsroom RSS. /feed, /feed/, /rss.xml and /feeds/all.rss all answer HTTP 200 with the same 538KB HTML landing page, and that page declares no RSS or Atom link anywhere. There is no feed to re-point to.

feeds.name: Micron Investor News
feeds.retired_reason: investors.micron.com moved behind a Cloudflare bot challenge: every candidate feed path answers 403 "Just a moment" to a non-browser client. Getting past that is bot-detection evasion, which this collector will not do. Unreachable, not moved.
